title: ‘I saw a picture of a two-year-old girl buried in mud. I knew we had to do something’ – This is climate breakdown
summary_full: When the floods hit Pakistan he went out to help. Then the water reached his own family. This is Imran Lodhi’s storyLocation: Dera Ghazi Khan, PakistanDisaster: Pakistan intense monsoon rainfallImran Lodhi is a university lecturer with a doctorate in climate change and sustainable development. The 41-year-old was living in Dera Ghazi Khan, a city in south-western Punjab, when floods devastated provinces across Pakistan. Climate change made the monsoon rainfall that caused the floods more intense. Continue reading...
